artists.biography: Anneke van Giersbergen (born March 8, 1973) was the singer in the Dutch band The Gathering from 1995 to 2007 when she announced her departure, summer 2007. She has since formed Agua de Annique with whom she released new songs in the fall of 2007. She has also worked with Devin Townsend Project, Danny Cavanagh & Anathema, Lawn, The Farmer Boys , Ayreon, Napalm Death, Globus, Moonspell, Giant Squid, Novembers Doom, Wetton/Downes, Maiden United and she has also done a live guest performance for Within Temptation. Her new album "The Darkest Skies Are The Brightest" is out now. Dianne van Giersbergen and Anneke van Giersbergen are both Dutch symphonic metal singers with the same last name. They are not related, but share a common last name, which is also the name of a small village in the Netherlands. They are both known for their strong vocal abilities and have achieved notable success in the symphonic metal scene. Read more on Last.fm. perplexity.description:
Symphonized," released on November 16, 2018, is a live album by Anneke van Giersbergen that showcases orchestral reinterpretations of her career-spanning work. The album features 11 tracks performed with the Residentie Orkest The Hague, a leading Dutch symphony orchestra, under the conduction of Arjan Tien. Rather than simply adding orchestral layers to a rock band setup, the arrangements by Marijn van Prooijen and Gijs Kramers rely solely on the orchestra's instrumentation, blending rock and classical elements into a cohesive symphonic rock experience. The repertoire draws from Anneke's solo material as well as songs from her projects VUUR, The Gentle Storm, and The Gathering, highlighting her versatility across genres such as rock, gothic metal, and classical crossover.

Positioned in Anneke van Giersbergen’s discography, "Symphonized" stands out as a unique live album that celebrates her 25-year career milestone by reimagining her music through orchestral arrangements. It follows her 2017 album with VUUR and precedes later solo works, serving as a reflective and ambitious project that bridges her metal and rock roots with classical sophistication. Critically, the album was well received for its artistic ambition and the quality of the orchestral collaboration, emphasizing Anneke’s vocal expressiveness and the lush, dynamic arrangements. Released by Inside Out Music and Sony Music, "Symphonized" is available in multiple formats including CD digipak, gatefold double LP with CD, and digital download.
